text:
Maria G: CI red on smoke-suite against hosted runtime — lots of failures in auth + toolcall tests. See CI: https://ci.internal/redwood/builds/9876
Aj Patel: Ack. Looking now. Which shard? Any flaky history?
Maria G: shard=smoke-3. First failure at step 'integration_test:hosted_endpoints' — failing ~5 tests. Logs excerpt:
```
FAILED tests/integration/test_auth.py::TestTokenRefresh::test_expired_token
E   AssertionError: 401 != 200
...
```
Samir K: Also seeing streaming/toolcall timeouts in same shard — toolcall fixture hangs right after the handshake.
CI Bot: Build 9876 status: failed — rerun requested by Maria G.
Oncall Ops: @here I'm oncall, can you paste the exact rerun command? I can queue it.
Maria G: ./scripts/ci/rerun.sh --build 9876 --shard smoke-3
Pete L: Started a bisect on the smoke-3 shard across commits 128a..HEAD, will report narrowed range.
Lee: FYI recent change to auth header normalization landed in PR #4123 — could be related.
Tara W: Any env diffs between CI image and hosted runtime?
Maria G: CI image tag used in build: redwood/runtime:2026-03-14. HOSTED_API_URL used for tests: https://hosted.api.redwood.ai
Aj Patel: Can we repro locally against staging-hosted? Steps?
Maria G: repro steps: export HOSTED_API_URL=https://staging.api.redwood.ai; pytest tests/integration/test_auth.py::TestTokenRefresh::test_expired_token -q
Samir K: Repro attempt shows same 401 after token refresh call. Captured network trace: https://logs.internal/redwood/trace/abc123
Pete L: Bisect narrowed it to commit 130f2 — that commit touches token handling in the runtime and tool proxy wrapper.
Maria G: If bisect confirms, plan is revert the small change and ship hotfix for hosted images, then run canaries.
Oncall Ops: Can we flip the fallback policy to model-compat for hosted to reduce customer impact while we fix? I'll flip the flag and watch.
CI Bot: Rerun queued: build 9876 shard smoke-3 (attempt 2).
Maria G: Run 2 results: auth tests now pass, toolcall tests still flaky (handshake occasionally times out).
Aj Patel: For toolcall, increase handshake timeout temporarily (10s -> 30s) and add extra logs around proxy negotiation so we can see where it stalls.
Lee: I'll open a PR to bump timeout and add trace logs in the proxy client.
Tara W: +1 on logs. Also add a short regression case to smoke to capture handshake timing.
Maria G: Good. Pete, once bisect + revert validated, can you push the rollback branch and trigger a dedicated image build?
Pete L: On it. Will tag rollback-130f2 and kick off image pipeline.
Samir K: Will follow up with packet captures and annotated traces in the incident thread.
Maria G: Thanks everyone. Action items: 1) Pete: rollback & image build, 2) Lee: timeout/logging PR, 3) Oncall Ops: toggle fallback while we validate, 4) Aj/Samir: add regression test + verify staging repro.
Oncall Ops: Done toggling fallback flag, watching metrics.
CI Bot: Build 9876 shard smoke-3 (attempt 3) queued by Pete L.
Maria G: Attempt 3: all auth tests green, toolcall tests mostly green — one intermittent failed handshake recorded. Keeping marauder test on for another hour.
Aj Patel: If flake count drops to zero in canary, we can merge rollback and ship.
Tara W: Also update flaky_suppression.yaml with this test id temporarily and create a follow-up to remove after the root fix.
Maria G: Closing loop here — we'll create a postmortem if rollback goes to prod. For now marking this thread resolved pending image bake and 2h canary. :thumbsup:
